gate_demotions.motive: The owner wants the public portfolio repository releasable under a permissive licence. The technically eligible Qwen2.5 bundle contains Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct under the non-commercial Qwen Research License; the Qwen3 bundle is Apache-2.0. This demotion was proposed after the four measurements were known and after it was known which bundle it favours.
gate_demotions.rationale: The check asserts a multi-turn serialization property: that appending a tool observation leaves the earlier tokenization byte-identical. BLUEPRINT_v2 section 3.1 and section 7.1 Stage 1 specify single-turn verifiable tool tasks for this lane, where one trajectory is tokenized once and assistant-only loss is taken over a single assistant block. That objective never exercises the demoted property. This is a scope argument, not a refutation of the measurement: Qwen3 fails this check reproducibly at both sizes, on its own native inference template as well as the project wrapper, and the cause is not diagnosed anywhere in this repository.
rearm_conditions: Rerun P5 with this check enforced as a hard gate on the M6 TRL 1.8 / no-Unsloth lane, with its own requirements input, lock, manifest and artifact.
Diagnose the root cause from the recorded first_prefix_divergence_index and the surrounding decoded windows.
Re-verify assistant-mask exactness on a trajectory with at least two appended tool observations.
gate_demotions.validity_precondition: Sound only while no Phase-A Stage-1 rollout appends a tool observation into an already-tokenized model context. If any Stage-1 arm or rung feeds an observation back, the property is in scope for that arm and this demotion does not cover it.
